name: tests
title: Test hardening - map coverage, write tests, prove them
titleAr: تقوية الاختبارات — مسح التغطية ← كتابة اختبارات ← إثباتها
description: No product code changes. Maps the current test landscape, writes the missing tests for the area you name, and proves they actually run green.

stages.title: Test landscape
stages.prompt:
Target area: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Map the existing test setup: runner, commands, file layout, naming and assertion conventions, plus what is already covered in the target area and what is NOT. Rank the gaps by risk. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the coverage gaps in analysis.md - write tests for these?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع الثغرات في analysis.md — أكتب اختبارات ليها؟
done: analysis.md names the test runner and the exact command that runs the suite
analysis.md lists uncovered behaviors ranked by risk, with file:line citations

stages.title: Write the tests
stages.prompt: Write tests for the gaps listed in .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Rules: follow the repository's existing test conventions exactly, do NOT modify product code, do not weaken or delete existing tests, and prefer behavioral assertions over snapshots. Write code-notes.md per your role contract.
done: New tests exist for the ranked gaps or the omission is justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md gives the command that runs the new tests

stages.title: Prove the suite
stages.prompt: Run the full suite in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Confirm the new tests actually execute (not skipped), that they are meaningful (would fail if the behavior broke), and that no existing test regressed. Write review.md and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
review.md quotes the suite output showing the new tests running green
review.md confirms no test was weakened or removed

stages.title: Fix failing tests
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL for the new tests in the project at {PROJECT} (details in .workbench/artifacts/review.md). Decide per failure whether the TEST is wrong or it caught a real product bug - state which, then fix accordingly. Never make a test pass by weakening its assertion. Write/append debug.md.
done: Each failure is classified as test-bug or product-bug with evidence
No assertion was weakened to force a pass

stages.title: Ship the tests
stages.prompt: The new tests PASSED review. Package them for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. Write ship.md.
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
